customManagers.description: The NATS images deploy/nats is tested with (scripts/nats_it.sh), the bootstrap example in its README, and the chart's values (paddock#42), pinned by tag and digest (paddock#36). No built-in manager reads a shell script, and the helm-values manager does not read fullImageName.

packageRules.description: The images deploy/compose/compose.yaml runs (paddock#39), pinned by tag and digest: the built-in docker-compose manager reads the file and bumps both. tests/test_compose.py fails an image without a digest.
